title: POI Common Definitions
description: Shared definitions for all travel planner agent outputs. SINGLE canonical format per field type. No format alternatives allowed.
$comment: M2 (spec-20260508-221237): a v2 sibling lives at schemas/v2/poi-common.schema.json; v2 introduces option_base / slot_envelope / city_context / provenance for the per-day file shape. v1 (this file) covers per-agent-output envelopes; both coexist until M3 migrates agents.

bilingual_name.description: A name in both base (English/romanized) and local (native script) languages.

name_base.description: Name in English or romanized form. REQUIRED non-empty.

name_local.description: Name in local/native script. Empty string if not available.

bilingual_location.description: A location/address in both base and local languages.

location_base.description: Location/address in English or romanized form.

location_local.description: Location/address in local/native script. Empty string if not available.

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates. CANONICAL FORMAT: {lat, lng}. Do NOT use {latitude, longitude}.

search_result.description: A search result. CANONICAL FORMAT: {skill, type, url, display_text}. Do NOT use {source, gaode_id}.

skill.description: The search skill/tool that produced this result (e.g., 'gaode-maps', 'google-maps', 'web-search').

display_text.description: Human-readable display text for the link.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., CNY, JPY, EUR). Inherits from plan-level or day-level currency_local. REQUIRED on every entry with a cost.

day_header.description: Standard day-level metadata required on every day entry in every agent file.

location.description: City or location for this day.

agent_envelope.description: The standard wrapper for all agent outputs.

agent.description: The name of the agent that produced this output.

status.description: Processing status. Currently only 'complete' is valid.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes from the agent about the data.
